# Processed pipeline data (not included — regenerated by preprocessing steps 06-11)

**Not included** in this repository: intermediate files produced by QC-filtering, dedup,
RBD extraction, splitting, and tree-feature/trajectory generation (steps 06-11 of the
preprocessing pipeline). Not hosted externally — regenerate by running the pipeline, since
these are cheap to reproduce given `data/raw/` (see `data/raw/README.md`) and the external
UShER download (see `data/usher/README.md`). The one exception is
`spike_aa/splits/config_tree2splits_split1.csv`, a small manifest that **is** tracked in git
(it's config, not generated data) and lives in this tree only because it's the path
`cluster/slurm/preprocessing/10_add_usher_tree_to_splits.sh` /
`11_gen_trajectories_tree_aware.sh` expect.

Expected contents, by subdirectory:

| Path | Written by | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `spike_aa/spike.parquet` / `.tsv` / `.fasta` | `cluster/slurm/preprocessing/06_filter_metadata.sh` | `07_rm_duplicates.sh` |
| `spike_aa/spike_nodup_location_coldate.parquet` / `.csv` | `07_rm_duplicates.sh` | `08_extract_rbd.sh` |
| `spike_aa/spike_with_rbd.parquet`, `spike_with_rbd_head1000.csv` | `08_extract_rbd.sh` | `09_splits_with_cutoff.sh` |
| `spike_aa/splits/split1_{train,test}_first3Omi2laterOmi.parquet` | `09_splits_with_cutoff.sh` | `10_add_usher_tree_to_splits.sh` (referenced from the config CSV below) |
| `spike_aa/splits/config_tree2splits_split1.csv` | tracked in git (manual/config, not generated) | `10_add_usher_tree_to_splits.sh`, `11_gen_trajectories_tree_aware.sh` |
| `spike_aa/splits/split1_{train,test}_first3Omi2laterOmi.with_mat.parquet` | `10_add_usher_tree_to_splits.sh` | `11_gen_trajectories_tree_aware.sh` (referenced from the config CSV's `out_parquet` column) |
| `spike_aa/trajectories/split1_{train,test}_first3Omi2laterOmi_pairs.parquet` | `11_gen_trajectories_tree_aware.sh` | `12_filter_trivial_trajectories.sh` |

Step 12's output is the final training/eval data and lives at the top-level `data/trajectories/`,
not here — see `data/trajectories/README.md`.

Regenerate by running `cluster/slurm/preprocessing/06` through `11` in order (see the
top-level [README.md](../README.md), "Data preprocessing").
